standard_prerequisites.name: The residual gerbe at a finite type point, together with the description of quasi-DM points through the automorphism group being locally quasi-finite
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked inside the counted proof (source lines 4296-4310)

standard_prerequisites.name: The structure of a one-point stack through a group scheme acting on a scheme, with the point corresponding to a section
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Used inside the counted proof (source lines 4311-4340)
standard_prerequisites.use: Presents the residual gerbe by a group action so that the automorphism group becomes a group algebraic space over the residue field.

standard_prerequisites.name: The statement that a locally quasi-finite group algebraic space over a field is a scheme with finite type structure, and the localization of a locally quasi-finite morphism at a point
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked inside the counted proof (source lines 4341-4380) as cross-chapter pointers
standard_prerequisites.use: Produces a finite flat group scheme map through which the cover is built.

standard_prerequisites.name: The criterion for local quasi-finiteness through discrete field fibres
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked near the end of the counted proof (source lines 4381-4400)
standard_prerequisites.use: Verifies that the constructed cover is locally quasi-finite.

core_obligations: Reduce to the one-point case: at a finite type point the quasi-DM condition means the automorphism group of the point is locally quasi-finite over the residue field, and it suffices to build the cover for the residual gerbe (proof lines 4295-4312)

Present the gerbe: write the residual gerbe as a quotient of the residue field by its automorphism group, so that the problem becomes that of a locally quasi-finite group algebraic space over a field (proof lines 4313-4345)

Produce a locally quasi-finite flat cover: use that such a group space is a scheme and choose a finite locally free subgroup meeting the local quasi-finiteness at the point, giving a flat cover whose fibres over field points are discrete (proof lines 4346-4398)

Conclude: the constructed morphism from a scheme to the stack is flat, surjective and locally quasi-finite by the discrete-fibre criterion, and assembling these over all finite type points gives the required cover (proof lines 4399-4402)
proof_roadmap: 对有限型点 x 作残差 gerbe Z_x；quasi-DM ⇒ G_x → Spec(k) 局部拟有限。
把 Z_x 写成 [Spec(k)/G_x]，问题化为「域上局部拟有限的群代数空间」。
该群空间是概型；取在某点处局部有限型的有限局部自由子群 ⇒ 得到平坦覆盖，其域上纤维离散。
由离散纤维判据该覆盖局部拟有限；对所有有限型点拼起来并用足够有限型点得满。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement is the author's theorem characterizing quasi-DM algebraic stacks through the existence of a surjective flat locally quasi-finite morphism from a scheme (source lines 4285-4293, label theorem-quasi-DM); the author's own proof at source lines 4295-4403 follows it immediately and is its proof. The proof reduces to the residual gerbe at a finite type point, rewrites it as a quotient of the residue field by the automorphism group of the point, uses the structure of a locally quasi-finite group algebraic space over a field to produce a flat cover with discrete field fibres, and assembles the covers over all finite type points (proof lines 4295-4402). The reduction to a one-point group quotient and the construction of the flat cover are the substance. H3.
